text.en:
The Office on Muslim Affairs is hereby placed back under the
oversight of the Office of the President.

All issuances, rules and regulations or parts thereof which are
inconsistent with this Executive Order is hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 20th day of March, in the year of our
Lord Two Thousand and Six.
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
PGMA Hologram # 34673
